title: Real Research Today: Immune System Reboot
definition: Today's documented research behind Immune System Reboot.
description:
The road to Immune System Reboot is already being paved. Phage therapy centers (e.g., UC San Diego IPATH) treat antibiotic-resistant infections. Brain-computer interface trials (Neuralink, Synchron) have implanted devices in human patients.

CRISPR-based therapies (Casgevy) won the first regulatory approvals for sickle cell disease in 2023. Together these programs form the apheresis suites foundation that Immune System Reboot will build on — the reboot logistics results, the stem rescue methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as reboot logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Immune System Reboot Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Immune System Reboot: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Immune System Reboot — resetting the immune system to clear autoimmunity.

Phase 1 — Prove (apheresis suites): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (reboot logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (stem rescue): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (tolerance training): reboot hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and immunology-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
